headline: Accounting Assistant
summary: Accountancy graduate looking for an accounting assistant role. I kept the books of our family hardware store part-time during my final year and prepared delivery receipts and billing statements during my OJT. I work accurately in Excel and keep supporting papers in order.

Encoded official receipts and filed them by customer and month.
